title: A domain-specific language for describing machine learning datasets
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper proposes a domain-specific language (DSL) for describing machine learning datasets, not a benchmark for measuring model performance or bias related to religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze religion, faith, or related biases. Its focus is on a domain-specific language for dataset documentation, with examples focusing on race, gender, and nationality.
